notes: Transcribed by a maintainer from the linked issue, which has the script.
No connector: the card was driven by Yubico's library; the tool's part is --prepare and --complete.
The card has no screen: the only review is package show on the host.
Sign: an identity inception (321-byte signed string), committed, fsck clean. The card signs a 32-byte digest the host computes; the host normalises to low s and finds v.
Size does not apply: the card sees a digest. Firmware below 5.7.0 carries Yubico advisory YSA-2024-03 for this curve.
